tools.name: list_benchmark_jobs
tools.description: Lists the ten everyday jobs in Agent Blueprint's measured agent cost benchmark (2 November 2026): what each job was, how big its input was, and the typical and worst-case tokens and dollar cost measured over five runs each on Claude Code and Codex. Use it to find the benchmark job closest to a task
